fee_notes: Standard fee is $35,000 paid in two installments ($25,000 at signing, $10,000 at lease signing). MUD Agreement second/subsequent shoppes: $25,000 (with $15,000 credited from Development Fee). Fee may be reduced or waived for non-traditional locations or pre-secured sites.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") is $35,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is due in two installments: (1) a non-refundable payment of $25,000 due when you sign the Franchise Agreement for your Bambū shoppe; and (2) a non-refundable payment of $10,000 due when you sign your lease for your Bambū shoppe.
